info.name: Insights.Api Balancing Mechanism Dynamic Balancing Services Adjustment - Disaggregated API
Disaggregated balancing services adjustment time series (DISBSAD)

params.name: from
params.description: The "from" start time or settlement date for the filter.

params.name: to
params.description: The "to" start time or settlement date for the filter.

params.name: settlementPeriodFrom
params.description: The "from" settlement period for the filter. This should be an integer from 1-50 inclusive.

params.name: settlementPeriodTo
params.description: The "to" settlement period for the filter. This should be an integer from 1-50 inclusive.

params.name: format
params.description: Response data format. Use json/xml to include metadata.

items.docs:
This endpoint provides disaggregated balancing services adjustment data batched by settlement period. Each
batch in the time series contains a summary of all records for that settlement period, detailing the number of
buy and sell actions, price information and volume information.

By default, the from and to parameters filter the data by start time inclusively. If the settlementPeriodFrom or

info.name: Disaggregated balancing services adjustment per settlement period (DISBSAD)

params.name: settlementPeriod
params.description: The settlement period to query. This should be an integer from 1-50 inclusive.

params.name: format
params.description: Response data format. Use json/xml to include metadata.

items.docs:
This endpoint provides disaggregated balancing services adjustment data for a single settlement period. The
response includes all the buying and selling actions that occurred during that settlement period.
            
Date parameter must be provided in the exact format yyyy-MM-dd.
